status: Confirmed corrections implemented and tested in an isolated candidate; comprehensive current-game factual sign-off remains OPEN.
scope: All 2255 existing shared references enumerated through the real controllers in Alchemy, Cooking and Processing, plus 1682 catalog records. This is not a claim of 2255 independently web-verified items.
baseline: Complete Recipe Fit and Source Labels 20261101 working snapshot, not Git HEAD. Prior full source and runnable are protected separately.
corrections: Gem of Twilight: Caphras Stone 1 -> 20000; Sunset Glow Crystal: 1 -> 10000. Fixed one-output semantics retained; actual Planner quantities tested.
Elixir of Perforation gains Pine Sap 5; Looney Elixir gains Powder of Flame 3; Defense Elixir uses Ash Sap 6. Actual Opportunities input costs tested.
Soft Bread uses standard Corn Dough 6; Red Bean Sirutteok replaces Salt 1 with Sugar 1.
Resplendent Boss Armor Reform Stones I-IV use Concentrated Boss Crystal 60; IV uses Rough Diamond 1.
Fourteen identical-input yield-display conflicts reconciled; Rice Flour and grain flour copies also retain the same complete grade options.
Red Pepper Powder has one route family, Hot Pepper 5 / High-Quality 2 / Special 1. Its retained 1-4 processing model is visibly ESTIMATED, not claimed measured or independently proven.

Nine exact fallback identities corrected: Oatmeal, Refined Oatmeal, Organic Feed, Caphras Essence, Daybreak Blue Coral, Good Feed, Special Honey Jar, Dark Spirit's Greed and Millennial Wild Ginseng. Ginseng previously pointed to a knowledge item; Greed now agrees with the existing Manage Currency catalog.
Antidote Elixir, Elixir of Burn Removal and Elixir of Hemostasis cooldowns corrected from 30 to 10 seconds; exact PC snapshot descriptions/effects agree.
Used for no longer silently stops at one consumer. Explicit eligible consumers and alternatives are retained; duplicate/hidden/archived exclusions remain.
Shared kind, description and acquisition facts no longer depend on the calling crafting tab. Explicit user recipe edits keep their own context.

Existing exchange facts are shared with normal reference windows, preserving input amounts, reward containers, limits and requirements. Legacy currency routes are not newly offered as current acquisition routes.
Perilla, Rice, Napa Cabbage and Radish gain short Morning Light gathering and Noyoung starter-seed guidance. Five grains gain exact starter-seed gathering guidance.

Source generation checks every reference, not just sparse cards: positive native market eligibility plus agreeing current IDs and exclusions; narrowly parsed gathering clauses and minimum Cooking/Alchemy levels retain restrictions.

Four explicitly reviewed retained aliases share only their exact identity's source facts; canonical and alias names both remain supported. Internal curation language is filtered out of user-facing source notes.
Sun-Dried Salt gains the documented rare Sea Water heating byproduct route. No new vendor-price or guaranteed-yield claim is introduced.
